scenarios.label: Normal · 100 workers, three decisions
scenarios.description: Healthy fan-out with three genuine human obligations and no population-level audit anomaly.

scenarios.label: 80 share one wrong premise
scenarios.description: Eighty locally healthy workers depend on the same invalid planning premise.

scenarios.label: Retries quietly explode
scenarios.description: Sixty workers recover locally after repeated retries, so the reducer sees successful outcomes.

scenarios.label: Verification coverage declines
scenarios.description: Forty-two workers complete without the expected independent verification boundary.

scenarios.label: Cost / compute burn spikes
scenarios.description: Seventy workers remain healthy while consuming much more compute than the plan expected.

scenarios.label: Healthy results share one stale source
scenarios.description: Seventy-five workers agree because they all depend on the same stale source snapshot.

scenarios.label: One merge group hides two product decisions
scenarios.description: The reducer fans two distinct product decisions into one obligation because they share a merge-group key.

scenarios.label: All systemic failures together
scenarios.description: A stress case combining premise concentration, retries, weak verification, cost burn, stale sources, and lossy fan-in.
